build_star_index.name: build_star_index
build_star_index.run:
shell("""
source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
module load star/2.7.10a
mkdir -p {params.star_dir}
STAR --runThreadN {threads} \
 --runMode genomeGenerate \
 --genomeDir {params.star_dir} \
 --genomeFastaFiles {input.fasta} \
 --sjdbGTFfile {input.gtf} \
 --sjdbOverhang 99
touch {output.done}
""")

 --outFileNamePrefix run_output/alignment/{wildcards.sample}/{wildcards.sample}_ \

 --sjdbGTFfile {input.gtf} \

""")

detect.name: detect
detect.description: Run circtools detect after prep, then annotate CircRNACount with gene names.
detect.run:
update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'detect', 'running')
try:
    shell("""
source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
module unload circtools || true
module load circtools/2.0
mkdir -p {params.outdir}
mkdir -p {params.temp}
circtools detect \
 @{input.samplesheet} \
 -D \
 -an {input.annotation} \
 -A {input.reference} \
 -Pi \
 -mt1 @{input.mate1} \
 -mt2 @{input.mate2} \
 -B @{input.bamlist} \
 -fg \
 -Nr {params.Nr} \
 -G \
 -k \
 -O {params.outdir} \
 -F \
 -t {params.temp}/ \
 -L 20 \
 -T {threads}
awk 'BEGIN {{FS=OFS="\t"}} NR==FNR {{key=$1 FS $2 FS $3; gene[key]=$4; next}} FNR==1 {{print "Gene", $0; next}} {{key=$1 FS $2 FS $3; g=(key in gene)?gene[key]:"not_annotated"; print g, $0}}' \
    {params.outdir}/CircCoordinates {params.outdir}/CircRNACount \
    > {output.named}
touch {output.done}
""")
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'detect', 'completed')
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'detect', 'error')
    raise e

ciriquant.name: ciriquant
ciriquant.run:
import yaml as _yaml
cq_cfg = {
    'name': config.get('organism', 'ref'),
    'tools': {
        'hisat2':   config['tools']['hisat2'],
        'bwa':      config['tools']['bwa'],
        'samtools': config['tools']['samtools'],
        'ciri2':    config['tools']['ciri2'],
    },
    'reference': {
        'fasta':       config['reference']['fasta'],
        'gtf':         config['reference']['gtf'],
        'bwa_index':   config['reference']['bwa_index'],
        'hisat_index': config['reference']['hisat_index'],
    }
}
cq_cfg_path = f"{params.outdir}/ciriquant_cfg.yaml"
os.makedirs(params.outdir, exist_ok=True)
with open(cq_cfg_path, 'w') as f:
    _yaml.dump(cq_cfg, f, default_flow_style=False)
update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'ciriquant', 'running')
try:
    shell("""
        source ~/circtools/bin/activate
        CIRIquant -t {threads} \\
                   -1 {input.r1} \\
                   -2 {input.r2} \\
                   --config """ + cq_cfg_path + """ \\
                   -o {params.outdir} \\
                   -p {params.prefix} \\
                   -e {output.log}
    """)
    shell('touch {output.done}')
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'ciriquant', 'completed')
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'ciriquant', 'failed')
    raise e

build_ciriquant_filelist.name: build_ciriquant_filelist
build_ciriquant_filelist.description: Generate a file listing all CIRIquant outputs for each sample.
build_ciriquant_filelist.run:
with open(output[0], 'w') as out:
    for sample in config['samples'].keys():
        ciri_file = Path(f"run_output/ciriquant/{sample}/circ/{sample}.ciri").resolve()
        out.write(f"{sample}\t{ciri_file}\n")

metatool.name: metatool
metatool.description: Run Circtools MetaTool to merge and normalize circRNA and linear counts.
metatool.run:
try:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "metatool", "running")

    shell("""
        source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
        module unload circtools || true
        module load circtools/2.0.3
        mkdir -p {params.outdir}

        cp {input.circ_count} {params.outdir}/CircRNACount
        cp {input.linear_count} {params.outdir}/LinearCount
        cp {input.coordinates} {params.outdir}/CircCoordinates


        circtools detect \
            -T {threads} \
            @{input.samplesheet} \
            -mt1 @{input.mate1} \
            -mt2 @{input.mate2} \
            -B @{input.bamlist} \
            -an {config[reference][gtf]} \
            -Pi -Nr {params.nr1} {params.nr2} \
            -A {config[reference][fasta]} \
            -cq -cql {input.ciriquant_list} \
            -O {params.outdir}

        # Step 2: merge CircRNACount and CircCoordinates
        awk 'BEGIN {FS=OFS="\t"} NR==FNR {key=$1 FS $2 FS $3; gene[$key]=$4; next} \
            FNR==1 {print "Gene", $0; next} \
            {key=$1 FS $2 FS $3; g=(key in gene)?gene[$key]:"not_annotated"; print g, $0}' \
            {params.outdir}/CircCoordinates {output.circ} \
            > {params.outdir}/CircRNACountName_Merged_Normalized.txt
    """)

    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "metatool", "completed")
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "metatool", "failed")
    raise e

circtest.name: circtest
circtest.description: Run Circtools CircTest differential circRNA expression analysis.
circtest.run:
try:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "circtest", "running")

    shell("""
        mkdir -p run_output/circtest_output
        mkdir -p run_output/circtest_ci

        echo "Original groups: {params.groups}"

        # Reorder inputs based on original group vector
        bash ../../app/scripts/reorder_circtest_inputs.sh \
            {input.circ} \
            {input.linear} \
            run_output/circtest_ci \
            "{params.groups}"

        # Build block grouping using pure bash (no python)
        BLOCK_GROUPS=$(echo "{params.groups}" | tr ',' '\n' | sort -n | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')

        echo "Block groups used: $BLOCK_GROUPS"

        # Run circtest on reordered data
        circtools circtest \
            -d run_output/circtest_ci/ \
            -c {params.columns} \
            -g $BLOCK_GROUPS \
            -l {params.labels} \
            -r {params.replicates} \
            -f {params.fdr} \
            -p {params.max_fdr} \
            -s 1 \
            -C 1 \
            -o run_output/circtest_output \
            -n test_output \
            -M bw

        touch {output.done}
    """)

    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "circtest", "completed")
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "circtest", "failed")
    raise e

conservation.name: conservation
conservation.condition: if CONSERVATION_GTF and CONSERVATION_FASTA and CONSERVATION_GENES:
conservation.description: Compute evolutionary conservation of circRNAs using circtools conservation.
conservation.run:
update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'conservation', 'running')

try:
    shell("""
        mkdir -p run_output/conservation_output

        source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
        module unload circtools || true
        module load circtools/2.0.3
        mkdir -p run_output/conservation_output/temp
        source ~/circtools/bin/activate
        export MPLBACKEND=Agg

        SPECIES_CONFIG_ARG=""
        if [ -n "{params.species_config}" ]; then
            SPECIES_CONFIG_ARG="-C {params.species_config}"
        fi

        circtools conservation \
            -d {input.circ_file} \
            -f {input.fasta} \
            -g {input.gtf} \
            -O {params.organism} \
            $SPECIES_CONFIG_ARG \
            -G {params.genes} \
            -o ./run_output/conservation_output/ \
            -t ./run_output/conservation_output/temp/ \
            -TS {params.target_species} \
            -pairwise

        touch {output.done}
    """)

    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'conservation', 'completed')
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'conservation', 'error')
    raise e

enrichment.name: enrichment
enrichment.condition: if ENRICHMENT_GTF and ENRICHMENT_FASTA and ENRICHMENT_PREFIX and REPEATS:
enrichment.description: Perform repeat enrichment analysis using circtools enrich module.
enrichment.run:
update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'enrichment', 'running')

try:
    shell("""
        mkdir -p run_output/enrich run_output/enrich/repeats run_output/enrich/output run_output/enrich/global_tmp

        echo "[2/5] Generating genes_and_introns.gtf..."
        bash ../../app/scripts/circtools_generate_intron_gtf.sh {input.gtf} run_output/enrich

        echo "[3/5] Extracting repeats..."
        wget https://links.jakobilab.org/repeat_selection_mm10.tar.bz2 -O repeats.tar.bz2
        tar --strip-components=1 -jxvf repeats.tar.bz2 -C run_output/enrich/repeats
        rm repeats.tar.bz2

        echo "[4/5] Generating flanking introns..."
        ../../app/scripts/circtools_generate_flanking_introns.py \
            -g run_output/enrich/genes_and_introns.gtf \
            -d {input.circ_coords} \
            > run_output/enrich/murine_flanking_introns.bed

        echo "[5/5] Running enrich for repeats..."
        for repeat in {params.repeats}; do
            tmp_dir="run_output/enrich/global_tmp/$repeat"
            mkdir -p "$tmp_dir"
            csv_out="run_output/enrich/output/${repeat}_output_2000_iter.csv"
            log_out="run_output/enrich/output/${repeat}_enrich.log"

            circtools enrich \
                -c run_output/enrich/murine_flanking_introns.bed \
                -b run_output/enrich/repeats/${repeat}.bed \
                -a run_output/enrich/genes_and_introns.gtf \
                -g run_output/enrich/mm10.chrom.sizes \
                -i 2000 -I intron -p {threads} -P 1 -T 1 \
                -o run_output/enrich/output/ \
                -F ${repeat} \
                -t "$tmp_dir" \
                > "$log_out" 2>&1 || true

            [ -f "$csv_out" ] || touch "$csv_out"
        done
    """)

    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'enrichment', 'completed')
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'enrichment', 'error')
    raise e

primer.name: primer
primer.description: Generate circRNA primer design reports using circtools primex (config-driven, no wildcards).
primer.run:
update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'primer', 'running')

try:
    shell("""
        set -euo pipefail

        source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
        module unload circtools || true
        module load circtools/2.0

        mkdir -p run_output/primer_output

        GENES="{params.genes}"

        for gene in $GENES; do

            awk -F '\t' "NR==1 || \$4 == \"$gene\"" \
                run_output/circtools_ci/CircCoordinates \
                > run_output/primer_output/CircCoordinates_${{gene}}.txt

            circtools primex \
                -d run_output/primer_output/CircCoordinates_${{gene}}.txt \
                -f {input.fasta} \
                -g {input.gtf} \
                -T ${{gene}}_primer_report \
                -O mm \
                -o run_output/primer_output/

        done

        touch {output.done}
    """)

    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'primer', 'completed')

except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'primer', 'error')
    raise e
